data.one_liner: Toggles between light and dark mode and persists the preference.
data.what_it_does: It provides widgets and utilities to easily toggle and persist the theme mode of a Flutter application using shared_preferences. It includes custom buttons and switches for changing the theme with animations.
use_when: You want a simple way to add light and dark mode toggling to your app.
You need automatic persistence of the user's theme selection.
avoid_when: You need advanced dynamic theming beyond basic light/dark modes (like custom seed color pickers or multi-theme engines).
strengths: Automatically persists theme choices using shared_preferences.
Comes with ready-to-use widgets like ReactiveThemeBtn and ReactiveSwitch.
weaknesses: Limited to light and dark mode toggling.
Not documented for complex theme engines or custom palettes.
